confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web search summaries of crowd-sourced cost-of-living data. The newest is Expatica citing Numbeo as of June 2026: inexpensive meal about $20, cappuccino about $5.47, 0.5 L domestic draught about $7 (we used about $6.50 for a standard serving). MyLifeElsewhere gives a $6 pint and a $5.31 cappuccino. The search results had no mid-range meal figure, so that number is an estimate from knowledge of typical US metro prices. Cocktail and wine are estimated from their usual price relationship to beer in Austin. The FX figure is the RBA 4pm AUD/USD observation for 18 Nov 2026, taken from a search summary of RBA pages. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates for the July 2026 window and were not checked against booking sites. Austin has few registered hostels, and its hotel prices change a lot with events and the season, so accommodation is the least certain part.
comparable_city_reasoning: Austin is a large US metro, pricier than the rest of Texas but cheaper than coastal cities like New York. It is comparable to Denver and Nashville for restaurant and hotel prices.
